meta.name: wayfinder
meta.description: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大块工作拆解为可逐步解决的决策任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要规划超过单次会话容量的复杂工作
copy.tagline_en: Break down large work into resolvable decision tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often plan complex work that exceeds a single session

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将一个大型模糊想法拆解成一系列决策票（decision tickets），放在你的问题追踪器（如 GitHub Issues）上，然后一次解决一张票，直到通往目标的路径清晰。它只做规划，不执行具体工作。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一个太大、无法在一次会话中完成的想法，且路径不清晰时触发。你可以说“我们来规划这个项目”或提供一个地图的 URL 来开始工作。

say.text: 帮我规划这个新功能：用户登录优化。
say.note: Claude 会开始对话，明确目标，然后创建地图和决策票。

say.text: 继续处理地图 #42 中的下一张票。
say.note: Claude 会加载地图，选择并解决下一张未阻塞的票。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude breaks a large vague idea into a series of decision tickets on your issue tracker, then resolves them one at a time until the path to the destination is clear. It plans only, not executes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give Claude an idea too large for one session and the path is unclear. You can say 'Let's plan this project' or provide a map URL to start working.

say_en.text: Help me plan this new feature: user login optimization.
Continue with the next ticket on map #42.
say_en.note: Claude will load the map, pick and resolve the next unblocked ticket.
